cases.title: Live on the Streets
cases.line: 50+ billboards across Belgrade, designed for the three seconds a driver gives them.
cases.challenge: Three schools in one group, all competing for the attention of teenagers and parents in a loud city. A driver gives a billboard a few seconds, and a new campaign was due almost every month.
cases.idea: Treat every billboard like the first three seconds of a reel: one message, one image, one move. Then a clean end frame that still works as a static poster.
cases.system: Each school gets its own colour, type and motion rules, so every new month starts from a system instead of a blank canvas. Every billboard ships with its social, web and email versions.
highlights: “The future is now” — AI school launch
cases.result_label: billboards live across Belgrade in two years
cases.result: Plus animated ads and animated academic calendars for both schools — one motion language across every street and screen.

cases.title: Ballies
cases.line: Three years of seasons, launches and mascots for a sports prediction platform.
cases.role: Digital Artist — campaigns, motion, characters, NFT art direction
cases.challenge: Explain a new kind of sports product — peer-to-peer predictions, tokens, AI picks — to sports fans every single day, without losing the hype.
cases.idea: Make it feel like sport, not finance: stadium light, neon green, mascots that fight, athletes mid-air. The product does the explaining. The visuals do the shouting.
cases.system: One visual language across every season — Ballies green, the hexagon badge and bold condensed type — plus a partnership template that kept collaborations (Gangverse, Loaded Lions, Pudgy Penguins) on-brand at any pace.
cases.result: Hundreds of assets across feeds, stories, banners and video — all in one recognisable universe.

cases.title: Key Art
cases.line: Cinematic composites built from generated elements, stock and a lot of light — delivered in 4K and 8K.
deliverables: Batman v Superman — Clash in the Rain (fan art)
cases.challenge: Make a single frame carry an entire story — an empire, a duel, an odyssey — at a size where every flaw shows.
cases.idea: Direct it like a film shot: write a scene bible, block the composition first, then generate and source every element separately so light, scale and depth stay under control.
cases.system: Elements are generated one by one and matched with stock, cut out, relit with rim light toward a single sun, and composited and graded in a Python + Photoshop pipeline that renders at any resolution.
highlights: Rim light, haze & grade in code
cases.result: Key art is where everything I know meets: composition, light, type and story — in one frame.
cases.note: Characters and titles in fan art belong to their owners.

cases.title: FSU 2026
cases.kicker: Campaigns & exhibition identities · Faculty of Contemporary Arts
cases.line: An art school, art-directed: 30+ campaigns, exhibitions and events in one year.
cases.client: FSU — Faculty of Contemporary Arts, Belgrade
cases.challenge: People judge an art faculty by its own posters. Every exhibition, lecture and enrolment deadline needed an identity good enough to hang in its own gallery.
cases.idea: Every show gets its own concept. The constant is the frame: FSU's typographic system, so twenty different worlds still read as one school.
cases.system: A shared header, type scale and colour logic (black, violet, signal yellow) holds the identities together, and every campaign ships as feed, story, email, website card and website strip.
highlights: Costume Design MA — “Your vision. Your design. Your future.”
FSU Doors — “Create it. Move it. What did you open?”
Masterpiece — “Every masterpiece starts with a first stroke.”
Enrolment 2027/28 — “Be creative. Be brave. Be yourself.”
cases.result: Across print, social, email, web and gallery walls — each one its own world, all of them clearly FSU.

cases.title: Series at Scale
cases.line: Eight series, 330+ assets, one system — careers, programmes, AI prompts, events and enrolment.
cases.client: ITS — Information Technology School · ITHS — IT High School
cases.challenge: Education marketing runs on volume: dozens of programmes, careers and deadlines, each needing its own post — without the feed turning into a template graveyard.
cases.idea: Give every series a strong, cinematic signature — portrait, light, type — and let the system carry the repetition, so post 33 looks as considered as post 1.
cases.system: Locked grids, type scales and colour rules per series, with copy and photography swapped in through a production pipeline. Every post ships in every format its channel needs.
highlights: Calories Tracker · NailBook · Budget Manager · Šapa
cases.result: A feed that looks art-directed post after post — and a production speed that keeps up with the academic calendar.

cases.title: Baby Boo
cases.line: Product films and stills made with AI — honey that pours on cue, glass you break in case of a sudden voyage.
cases.client: Baby Boo — natural cosmetics “made by moms”
cases.challenge: Premium product imagery and video for a small brand — without a studio, a crew or a shoot day.
cases.idea: Direct AI like a camera crew: packaging true to the real product, honey that pours on cue, bees in shallow focus — and a bold concept in every still. Then edit and grade it like a real commercial.
cases.system: A product-true reference set keeps labels, mascots and proportions consistent across every generation; films are cut, timed and graded in Premiere and After Effects.
highlights: Break glass in case of a sudden voyage
cases.result: Vertical-first product films ready for Reels and TikTok, a 4K master for the web, and a library of concept stills for every launch.
